name: LibreSprite/LibreSprite
description: LibreSprite is a free, open-source animated sprite editor and pixel art tool, forked from the last GPL-licensed version of Aseprite. Supports layers, frames, onion skinning, and multiple platforms.
score_rationale: 7.4k stars, the leading free/open-source alternative to Aseprite for pixel art, with active development and broad platform support.
summary: Free GPL Aseprite fork with layers, frames, and onion skinning
